verdicts.reason: A puts an oversized CTA first so it outweighs the headline, and the reading order runs action → message. The eyebrow touches the top edge, the logo and controller shrink to unreadable chips under the headline, and the date card is a tiny, illegible block stranded at the far right after a dead gap. B reads in a better order (logo → headline → CTA), but the eyebrow floats on its own above the CTA, the date card and controller are just as tiny and illegible, and the body copy is crammed into a narrow 3-line column against the right edge, so the date/time info is effectively lost in both.
